violations.text: The 3-bay sink area is lacking a hand-washing sink. Hand sink is to be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The door to the outside, located in the backroom storage area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium tablet sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Test strips are to be acquired. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The hose attached to the water filtration system backflow prevention valve is directed to drain into the 3-bay sink. Hose is to be adjusted and redirected to drain into the utility sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The ceiling over the 3-bay sink area, and the wall behind the 3 bay sink area are covered with materials that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. List of proper materials for indoor areas provided at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The following areas of physical the facilities were observed in poor repair: - ceiling tiles in the backroom area were observed stained/cracked/missing - seams to the floor/wall/ceiling coverings in the walk-in cooler were observed to be open exposing the inner structure. Seams are to be sealed - coving to the floor/wall juncture in the backroom areas observed missing New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026
